verdict.rationale: Mollie's Subscriptions and Recurring Payments APIs support charging customers automatically at a set interval (mollie-docs-6, mollie-docs-7), which covers basic recurring billing, but the evidence never mentions plan objects, trial periods, plan upgrades/downgrades, or proration logic that this story explicitly asks for. missing for 10: documented plan/trial support, upgrade/downgrade handling, proration calculations, and any first-party or independent example implementing these.
